format_finding.summary: Season 1 was not a fixed eight-man bracket. Each division started with eight fighters. Team challenges eliminated fighters without a fight early on, and later decided which team picked the next matchup. The loser of a house fight left, so a fighter could fight more than once and others reached the last four without fighting. After the elimination fights, four remained per division for the semi-finals, and an injured semi-finalist was replaced by a previously eliminated fighter he chose.

network_metadata_defects.defect: Paramount+ titles agree with every other source (11 = Middleweight Semi-Final #2, 12 = Light Heavyweight Semi-Finals) but the two descriptions are swapped: item 11 describes the light heavyweight semi-finals and item 12 the last middleweight final spot. Use the titles; use those two descriptions only for pairings, never for episode placement.

the display airdate field is one day later than listing_date for every episode (Jan 18 vs Jan 17, 2005, …), consistent with a UTC rendering; listing_date equals Wikipedia's IMDb-cited original airdate for all 12 episodes.
